definitions.gloss: writing on behalf of another, ghostwriting
definitions.explanation: The act of writing something in place of another person, either because they cannot write themselves or because they have asked someone else to write for them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{代筆|だいひつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I wrote a letter on behalf of my mother.

examples.japanese: {怪我|けが}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{右手|みぎて}→右手：10438_migite⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}えない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{代筆|だいひつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: Since I couldn't use my right hand due to an injury, I asked a friend to write for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{代筆|だいひつ}だったらしい。
examples.english: This novel came out under a famous author's name, but apparently it was ghostwritten.

notes:
USAGE:
Covers both practical situations (writing for someone who is injured or illiterate) and professional ghostwriting. Can be used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代筆|だいひつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to write on behalf of)
- {代筆|だいひつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to ask someone to write for you)
- {代筆|だいひつ}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (ghostwriter, scribe)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ゴーストライター→ゴーストライター：27525_goosutoraitaa⟧: ghostwriter — specifically for professional authorship
- ⟦{代書|だいしょ}→代書：18563_daisho⟧: writing official documents on behalf of another (more formal/legal)
